// REQ: LANG-2131 LANG-2132 LANG-2133 LANG-2134
-- Sales measures
Total Sales = SUM ( Sales[Amount] )
Sales LY =
VAR ly = CALCULATE ( [Total Sales], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( 'Date'[Date] ) )
RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( ly ), 0, DIVIDE ( [Total Sales] - ly, ly ) )
/* Top products */
EVALUATE TOPN ( 10, FILTER ( ALL ( Product ), [Total Sales] > 1000 && TRUE ), [Total Sales], DESC )
